QuestInfo.name: [Event] Retro World Opens!
QuestInfo.0:
#e#bRetro World Event#k#n

#b[Event Period]#k
3/6/2019 After Maintenance - 4/9/2019 11:59 PM

Retro World, a new game created by Game Master Jun, has opened! Come give this unique spin on adventuring a try!

#b[Retro Coin]#k
You'll earn Retro Points by taking part in Retro World events. Every time you rack up 100 Retro Points, they'll be converted into 1 Retro Coin, good for purchasing special items.

#b[Demon King's Tower]#k
An evil king is said to reside in the mysterious tower that appeared on the outskirts of Balina in Retro World. Many champions have challenged the tower, but none have beaten the king. If you think you can succeed where they failed, this is your chance.
